policy_check.caveat: Demand is realised sales (units shipped), which understates true demand when stock ran out; costs are assumed; there is no carry-over inventory or lead time. Uplift is measured in assumed-GBP and can be negative.
policy_check.description: Rolling replay on real weekly demand: each of the last 26 weeks, order Q = forecast + sigma * z(cf) (newsvendor) versus Q = forecast (mean order) and Q = last year's week (seasonal-naive order); realised profit uses actual units sold. Forecast = mean4 backtest forecast; sigma = std of its earlier one-step errors. Costs are the SIMULATED defaults (cost 0.60, salvage 0.20 of cost).
